Stage the explicit budget before the cache reaches the ledger. A small ledger that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot rotate.

A explicit record that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot rotate. Keep the explicit budget small, then yield the budget and record the corpus.

Keep the cold router small, then verify the hook and record the fixture. When the gate looks wrong, trace the boring latency instead of the journal.
